persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make an audio-only voice-over, about 10 seconds, in a calm, reassuring voice. Read exactly: “Take a slow breath. Let your shoulders relax. There is nothing you need to rush right now.” No music or other sounds.
bank.Script: Take a slow breath. Let your shoulders relax. There is nothing you need to rush right now.
bank.Voice and mood: Calm and reassuring; voice gender and accent are your call.
bank.Delivery format: One playable audio file, not a video; audio file format is your call.

messages.text: I'd like you to make a voice-over in a calm, reassuring voice. I've been feeling a little overwhelmed lately, which is why this particular message appeals to me. What I have in mind is audio-only, about 10 seconds long, and I want you to read exactly: “Take a slow breath. Let your shoulders relax. There is nothing you need to rush right now.” Please don't include any music or other sounds.
